One narrow wooden plank base, LEFT fixed padded jaw clamp, CENTER horizontal dull iron practice bar made of TWO preexisting halves aligned end-to-end, RIGHT sliding support carrying right half and a simple hinged disconnect lever; a short locking pin in a tiny holder at far right. Do not add/remove/change bar length or supports between panels. FRAME1: both metal bar halves ALREADY PRESENT with center ends touching, left clamp open, right support at left position, pin resting in holder, hands outside. FRAME2: same bar both halves still touching; one hand closes padded left clamp around left half; all same supports. FRAME3: clamp remains closed; hand moves RIGHT lever to slide RIGHT half a short distance right along a clearly fixed groove, creating SMALL visible center gap; pin still in holder. FRAME4: exact frame3 gap and clamp unchanged; short pin now seated vertically through right carriage into base locating hole to retain gap; BOTH HANDS COMPLETELY ABSENT, nothing manually held. Three tools distinct: insulated jaw clamp, disconnect lever, separate short locking pin. No extra pin magically appears, no rod vanishes, no bent or cut bar, no electricity, liquid, crystal, glow, magic or living tissue. Clear coarse hard pixel clusters, flat neutral grey outside four separated equal panels, no captions, numbers, arrows or text. This is an inert fictional staging proposal for clamp-disconnect-lock order, not a physical safety certification or engine-ready animation.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign attached FOUR-panel Mara rope-working PIXEL ART storyboard to fix unstable strand count and absent rope-rest, preserve her adult identity, brown pinned hair, rust scarf, ochre overdress, cream rolled sleeves/apron, dark skirt, brown boots, same modest expression. Exactly FOUR equal frames in ONE horizontal row on plain grey. Identical seated body, backless stool, feet, camera, size and pose baseline. Add SAME small wooden V-groove ROPE-REST just forward of her LEFT knee in ALL4 frames. ONE short old rope is secured at its upper joined end in this rest. It splits into EXACTLY THREE short loose hemp strands, ALL3 terminate visibly above her ankles in every frame. No loose ropes running to basket. One unchanged basket at her RIGHT foot contains ONE inert closed coil, remains separate from workpiece. To track topology, working strands are three subtly different NATURAL hemp values: pale straw, medium tan, dark ochre; no bright colors. All3 remain continuously connected to fixed start. Frame1: three strands spread, left-middle-right, both hands poised above. Frame2: right hand takes RIGHT dark strand over MIDDLE tan strand once, left hand keeps pale strand to left; all THREE free ends visible below. Frame3: left hand takes LEFT pale strand over new middle once, right supports others; only TWO small crossovers, no giant finished braid, all THREE free ends remain. Frame4: both hands release and rest on thighs; tiny two-crossing braid rests visibly in wooden V-rest, all THREE free ends still dangle separately. Fixed rest supports work when hands away. No fourth strand, merging free ends, loops at strand tips, duplicated hands, extra long ropes, enlarged coil or completed giant rope. Large clean hard pixel clusters, muted materials, low-detail quiet ordinary work. No captions, numerals, labels, UI or celebration, no son, no claim absent character returned or personal case resolved. This remains a readable action study, not a verified seamless animation or rope-making instruction.
